dialogues.speaker: Words on the Lamp
dialogues.text: I know the way! But those Jibashiri just had to say that I got lost, and even scolded me for crying over a small matter...

dialogues.speaker: Words on the Lamp
dialogues.text: I wasn't lost! And I didn't cry over some small thing!

dialogues.speaker: Words on the Lamp
dialogues.text: ...I'll just leave a marking in the future...
